reviews.text: My two dogs are always taken care of there, and I can recommend it.

My dog ​​was suffering from severe vomiting and diarrhea, so I urgently requested a visit to this clinic near my home. Even though it was close to closing time, they took the time to carefully perform blood tests, ultrasound examinations, and other procedures. Thanks to their care, I was able to get a good night's sleep, and the next morning my dog ​​was a little better, which was a great relief.

The receptionist, nurses, and veterinarian were all very kind and took excellent care of both me and my dog. Thank you very much.

My dog ​​broke a bone over the New Year holidays... Our usual veterinary clinic was closed, but Crown was open, so even though they were fully booked, they still came to see us after we explained the situation. They were very kind, and since the orthopedic surgeon wasn't available that day, they told us we needed to hurry up with the treatment and found another hospital for us, which really helped us out!

I've been a patient at Crown Clinic since February.
At my previous veterinary clinic, a newly qualified veterinarian treated my dog ​​roughly, and the head veterinarian was also very dismissive (I knew more about treatment methods than that young veterinarian). I'd been going to that veterinary clinic for years... what was that all about...?
I was so frustrated that they didn't even know the basic treatment methods that even a layperson could understand... so while waiting to pay at that clinic, I made an appointment with Crown Clinic.
I rushed to Crown Clinic and I'm truly grateful for their prompt service.
I work in a job where I have many opportunities to interact with dogs, so since my dog's visits, I've been recommending Crown Clinic to everyone. Everyone I've recommended them to has said they were glad they went to Crown Clinic.
I'm truly grateful to Crown Clinic.
However, every time I ask them to express my dog's anal glands, he gets diarrhea, and there are many mistakes with the medication. I've recommended them to many people, but... why does he get diarrhea every time we go? I was so traumatized that I went to a different veterinary clinic for nail trimming and anal gland expression, and he didn't get diarrhea.
I wish they would do it in front of me.

365-day consultation available
I was so grateful that they were able to provide appropriate hospitalization and treatment for my cat who became ill on New Year's Eve.

We have been established customers here since 2 years . Amazing staff and very animal friendly. Grooming services are very thorough and service oriented. They also have an English speaking vet , Nagahara sensei , who treated our dog yesterday.  Overall , a very clean and customer friendly place. Only downside is that the groomers do not speak English . Had to use Google translate to make it work . Highly recommend.

We have been using this veterinary clinic since February of this year. At our previous veterinary clinic, our dog was prescribed several kinds of medications and supplements, but they did not seem to have any effect, and the daily medication was stressful for both the dog and the owner. Since we started taking our dog here and changed his food, he has been in good health without needing any medication, which makes us very happy. All the staff are cheerful and friendly, and we are so glad we switched hospitals.
Since moving, we have mainly been using the hotel for regular checkups. My child seems to enjoy staying at the hotel and refuses to go home 😄 I can leave him there with peace of mind. …
I came to buy dog ​​food. I usually come in for teeth cleaning. I appreciate the consistently courteous service.

The doctor and staff saved my cat's life. The doctor had an operation scheduled that day, but they took the time to help my cat, who was in a critical condition. They offered suggestions on what to do and what measures to take, and my cat can still live.

She has various illnesses, but I have no words to express my gratitude. Thank you.

I had been a patient for several years, but I've decided to discontinue my treatment after witnessing extremely careless handling of my pet during hospitalization and surgery.

During the removal of stitches, I witnessed the vet forcibly peeling off a mat of hair that had adhered to the sutured area, causing re-bleeding, and confidently stating that it was fine. It was so painful to watch that I couldn't bear to look.

While I appreciate their efforts in treating my pet's abdominal surgery due to foreign body ingestion, the ¥150,000 charge for the stomach and intestines separately, totaling ¥300,000, should have been explained, even after the procedure. The large discrepancy between the pre-procedure estimate and the final cost, the lack of explanation, and the hurried, vague explanation they offered after seeing my shock were extremely disappointing.

They offer phone consultations, and regular health checkups and tests aren't excessively expensive, which is good. It's a valuable hospital with a CT scanner, so I think it's reliable in emergencies, but you should confirm the estimate before treatment and carefully examine the invoice.


→They contacted me, apologized, and acknowledged that they sincerely accepted the shortcomings in communication and coordination, as well as the handling of the sick animal, and the issue has been resolved.

This veterinary hospital has top-notch staff and facilities.

My cat had unexplained symptoms and was examined at about five other veterinary hospitals, but they told me they couldn't identify the cause or gave me random, off-the-chart prescriptions. By the time we finally took him here, his condition was terminal. His life was uncertain, but the director suggested and implemented the best palliative care possible, and after about two months of care, he was able to pass away peacefully. I'm confident that this veterinary hospital, with its doctors, nurses, and staff, provides treatment that is tailored to both pets and owners.

There are many veterinary hospitals in this area, and even after searching online, I couldn't find Crown Animal Hospital easily. I realized that the choice of hospital can greatly affect a pet's fate.

I regret and regret that if I had taken him here when his symptoms first appeared, he might have still been alive.

We have several other cats in our household, and I think it was the cat who died for them that led us to Crown Animal Hospital.
